HOW RATINGS & STANDINGS WORK

Player OVR uses position weights, role strengths and calibrated scaling. Team grades use 24 core depth-chart slots, with premium-position weights. QB contributes 20% of OFF; edge rushers contribute 28% of DEF. WR2/WR3 and CB2/CB3 count; other reserves contribute when promoted. Team OVR: 45% OFF / 45% DEF / 10% starting K and P. A 99 team requires a 99 starting K and P. First-season placement games use seeded division ranks. Later seasons use final division standings. Standings ties: division record, point differential, points scored, then team order. Seven playoff seeds per conference · Division winners lead seeds 1–4 · Divisional round reseeds.
